temporary_non_gateway_override.scope: worker, PostgreSQL, ZITADEL API/login/database/proxy, and candidate init services; app/Gateway is excluded
temporary_non_gateway_override.removal_condition: remove shared Coolify MOBILE_MEDIA_* variables, deploy the Gateway-only encrypted file-storage configuration, and verify every service

source_fix.root_cause: Coolify 4.7.5 merges application-wide runtime variables into every Compose service after service-level environment entries and resets each service env_file list to .env during deployment, so blank worker entries and a custom env_file did not isolate globally configured media credentials.
source_fix.current_source_change: Renderer strips MOBILE_MEDIA_* from Compose service environment values and mounts an encrypted Coolify File Storage file read-only in the Gateway. The Coolify deployment configuration must also remove those names from the shared application environment. The runtime validates the 0400 owner-only file, accepts only the MOBILE_MEDIA_* allowlist, validates the configured provider, and passes the values only to the API child; other workers receive neither the path nor media values. This avoids Coolify replacing Compose env_file lists during deployment. Generated Compose check passed locally; exact-head CI/Security and candidate rollout remain pending.
source_fix.deployment: Coolify deployment yr4y2ece2ji3n10fsxrwgedx finished on a819cab04723cc4fc230ac8f61ac011a2001ea50. It deployed the prior worker-only Compose change; temporary override was expanded to clear all non-Gateway services.
